records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total revenue for the second quarter of 2021 increased by $52.5 million to $475.0 million as compared to the second quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Tractors are operated with a solo driver or, when handling more time-sensitive, higher-margin freight, a team of two drivers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our Variant business model directly addresses our drivers’ frustrations as our model delivers higher utilization and pay which has directly contributed to a significant drop in turnover.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our profitability decreased largely as a result of 10.9% fewer available tractors combined with increases in technology and personnel expenses and higher net fuel costs partially offset by an increase in our Brokerage gross margin to 12.0% compared to 8.1% in the prior year quarter on higher Brokerage revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income for the second quarter of 2021 was $8.9 million compared to $16.3 million in the second quarter of 2020.
